description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractErrorParser' used in the AWS SDK for PHP to parse error responses from AWS services. It provides methods for extracting payloads and populating error shape data from HTTP responses, supporting error handling in AWS API interactions.

classes.name: AbstractErrorParser
classes.description: An abstract class providing mechanisms for parsing error responses from AWS services, serving as a base for concrete error parsers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser with an optional Service instance.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Abstract method to parse the payload from response and structure shape; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Extracts the payload from a response based on whether the structure shape is a StructureShape or streaming.

methods.name: populateShape
methods.description: Populates error data shape from response, matching error codes to known error shapes and extracting relevant headers or status codes.
